name: btop
summary: Resource monitor TUI (CPU, memory, disks, network, processes) with full-color gradient themes in .theme files. Windows uses the separate btop4win port.
configFormat: btop.conf (key = value, auto generated) plus <name>.theme files (theme[key]="#hex")

install.notes: btop4win 1.0.5, a separate Windows port (not btop 1.4.x).
Scoop's `btop` is btop4win; `btop-lhm` adds LibreHardwareMonitor sensors.

config: btop4win install folder (next to btop4win.exe): btop.conf, themes/
windows.notes: Not installed on the verification machine: facts from the btop4win README. Config, logs and the themes folder sit in the same folder as btop4win.exe, so a scoop upgrade may replace them; check scoop's persist rules before relying on edits. Graphs default to the TTY symbol set on Windows for font compatibility; Cascadia Code or a Nerd Font gives braille.
